gameDescriptionHtml:
Hell Galaxy is a thrilling singleplayer space shooter that blends weird fiction, dark gritty sci-fi, and transhumanism into a unique gaming experience. Take control of a raider — an ex-convict turned bio-ship hybrid — and carve out your place in the dangerous Galaxy of Neterun, where you have been exiled for eternity.

Become The Ship
Accused of murder and stripped of your human body, you awaken as something new: a consciousness fused into the metal shell of a bio-ship. Flesh and bone are a memory — what’s left of you now lives in the hull, the modules, the guns you bolt onto yourself. In Neterun there is no going back to human, only forward, into whatever deadlier thing you choose to become. Rise above rival raiders and uncover the secrets buried in ancient Neterunian ruins.

Kill Or Be Killed
Every encounter in Neterun is a fight on two fronts: your hull can be torn apart, but so can your mind. Shift your focus between balanced, aggressive, and defensive states and adapt on the fly to what’s hunting you — the ghostly creatures of this galaxy threaten your sanity as much as your armor. Read each enemy, reconfigure your build, and choose which part of yourself you’re willing to risk: the ship that keeps you alive, or the mind that keeps you you.

Forget Your Humanity
Your survival depends on a fully customizable ship. Gather resources and install modules, starting from your cockpit, to reshape yourself into an ever-deadlier raider.

Experiment with countlessc ombinations and adapt to the dangers of exile — no two raiders have to be built the same way.

Dive into Neterun
Explore a visually stunning galaxy rich with forgotten lore, shadowy ruins, and hostile creatures that threaten both body and mind. Encounter rival raiders, uncover the stories of other exiles, and piece together a world where humanity is only a distant memory.
